title: Call Chase McLaughlin anything you want, just call him perfect
text:
Call Chase McLaughlin anything you want, just call him perfect

 Call Chase McLaughlin anything you want, just call him perfect
 The place-kicker has not missed a field-goal or extra-point attempt this season and Thursday was named NFC Special Teams Player of the Month.     .   Bucs place-kicker Chase McLaughlin, shown celebrating a field goal last month against the Steelers, has made each of his 19 field-goal attempts and 17 point-after tries this season. [ JEFFEREE WOO | Times ] Rick Stroud is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Reach him at rstroud@tampabay.com.
